r2_requirement: Use a separate branch. Do not edit R1 protocol, tasks, thresholds, or result. Build a materially richer outcome-calibrated utility model from a disjoint historical apprenticeship partition and evaluate on different historical replay tasks before any official holdout selection.
prohibited_r2_shortcuts: do not lower the R1 retrieval gate
do not reuse the three R1 replay tasks as R2 evaluation targets
do not tune coefficients directly to the R1 outcome ordering
do not promote performance-only historical records to causal evidence
do not select official FVD holdouts until a successor development gate explicitly passes
